panels.title: Sails on the horizon
panels.desc: From the parapet of a high coastal watchtower at dusk, a guard spots dark sails on the horizon; below in the cove, the island's war galleys sit moored at the stone quays.
panels.scene: Twilight over the western sea of Paxos. On the high stone parapet of the North Bluff watchtower, an armored coastal guard leans over the crenellations, shading his eyes as dark square sails appear on the distant sea. Behind the tower, down in the sheltered cove below, the island's fleet of slim wooden war galleys rests in rows at the stone quays, their oars stowed and crews looking up toward the watchtowers for the signal fire.

panels.title: The sleepy guard
panels.desc: Inside the stone watchtower at South Crag: an oil lamp gutters in the draft; the lone guard has slumped face-down over his unsealed wax slates, fast asleep, while the dark sea churns outside.
panels.scene: Inside the circular stone chamber of the South Crag watchtower. A bronze oil lamp flickers in the draft from the narrow arrow-slit. The lone watchman has slumped forward face-down onto his wooden slate-table, arms folded beneath his head, dead asleep. Beside his hand lie unsealed wax slates from the other towers and an unlit torch. Outside the arrow-slit, waves crash against the cliff in the deepening night.
panels.caption: THE SLEEPY GUARD: ASLEEP FOR AN HOUR, OR STRUCK DOWN FOR GOOD? NO ONE ON THE OTHER HEADLANDS CAN TELL.

panels.title: The balanced scales of war
panels.desc: An allegorical vision: two signal braziers balanced on a wooden beam atop the cliffs; one burns white (ATTACK), one burns black (DEFEND), perfectly level as coastal mist swirls around them.
panels.scene: An allegorical scene above the sea cliffs. A great wooden beam balance stands poised on a sharp headland crag. In one iron basket, a signal brazier blazes with brilliant white flame (to launch the fleet); in the other, a brazier billows with thick black pine-smoke (to hold the harbor). The beam is poised in dead level balance, neither tipping. Around the crag, sea fog drifts and swirls, while below on the water, the dark shapes of two approaching fleets wait in shadow.
panels.caption: A BIVALENT DEFENSE: BOTH SIGNALS BALANCED ON THE RIDGE. THE PROOF SHOWS HOW DELAY KEEPS THEM HOVERING FOREVER.

panels.title: The chain of watchtowers
panels.desc: Four watchtowers perched along the rocky headlands in silhouette; from left to right, signal braziers change from white flame to black smoke, while at the pivotal tower, the brazier is dark and silent.
panels.scene: A panoramic twilight view of four watchtowers perched along the high rocky headlands of Paxos, seen in silhouette against a pale violet sky. From left to right, the signal braziers on the towers shift: the first two burn with white flame (Attack), the fourth burns with black smoke (Defend). At the third tower—the pivotal headland where the verdict flips—the brazier is cold and dark, its guard slumped over the stone sill asleep.
panels.cast: four watchtowers with guards in silhouette
panels.caption: CHANGE ONE SIGHTING AT A TIME FROM ALL-ATTACK TO ALL-DEFEND. SOMEWHERE THE FATE FLIPS — AND THE GUARD WHOSE WORD FLIPPED IT MAY SIMPLY BE ASLEEP.

panels.title: The crossroads on the cliffs
panels.desc: A messenger pauses at a fork in the coastal cliff path, holding two sealed leather message cylinders, while below in the dark harbor the crews wait by their galleys.
panels.scene: A steep, rocky fork in the cliffside footpath high above the surf. A young courier in a chiton pauses by a stone cairn, holding two sealed leather message cylinders, one in each hand, hesitating which headland track to take first as waves spray below. Far across the bay, torches gleam from the ramparts of two rival watchtowers, each awaiting his arrival to know whether to sound the horn.
sites: cliff path fork above the sea
panels.caption: CASE 2: IF THE FATE OF THE ISLAND HANGS ON WHICH SLATE ONE GUARD READS FIRST, THE REST MUST BE ABLE TO DECIDE WITHOUT HIM — AND THEN IT HANGS ON NOTHING.

panels.title: The endless vigil
panels.desc: Midnight over the island: runners jog along coastal paths, delivering slates from tower to tower under the moon; inside the towers, guards argue over their boards while the war galleys remain chained in the dark harbor.
panels.scene: A wide moonlit night across the headlands of Paxos. Long trails wind along the ridge lines, with fast runners carrying torches passing each other between towers, delivering every slate in turn without fail. Inside the glowing watchtowers, guards pore over their chalk slate boards, locked in endless debate. Down in the coves, the island's war galleys sit motionless behind the heavy harbor chains, crewed by silent soldiers waiting for a signal that never comes.
panels.cast: runners on trails, guards in towers, silent galley crews
panels.caption: NO SLATE IS LOST. NO TOWER CRUMBLES. EVERY RUNNER ARRIVES. AND THE FLEET NEVER LAUNCHES.

panels.title: Dawn on the headlands
panels.desc: Sunrise over the sea: the coastal fog clears, and guards at the waking towers blow their bronze horns across the bay, seeing clearly who answered the dawn roll-call before the battle begins.
panels.scene: Dawn breaking in gold and rose over the eastern headlands. The night fog rolls out to sea. On three of the four watchtowers, guards in bronze helmets raise long curved war-horns, sounding a clear, triumphant note in unison across the calm water. At the empty fourth tower in the distance, a banner droops untouched, but the waking majority has already formed its line and the galleys are rowing out in formation.
panels.cast: waking guards with bronze horns, rowing galleys below
panels.caption: THE GUARDS WHO NEVER ANSWERED: IF THOSE WHO SLEEP WERE ALREADY ASLEEP AT DUSK, THE WAKING TOWERS CAN SAFELY SOUND THE CALL.
